description: Use this when the user wants 2 to 4 data center candidates side by side, coordinates or named markets, e.g. "39.04,-77.48 vs 33.45,-112.07 for 50 MW" or "Dallas vs Columbus". Pass locations as a list of "lat,lon" strings or market names. Coordinates return the same composite read for each site (verdict, coverage, limiting factor, and scores where available) and the winner with its rationale when the source provides one. Market names return each market scorecard (DCPI verdict and bands); no winner is computed for markets. capacity_mw is echoed and does not change scores. For one site use evaluate_site; to rank many markets use rank_markets.

capacity_mw.description: Target load in megawatts, echoed per candidate

locations.description: 2 to 4 candidates, each "lat,lon" or a market name, for example ["39.04,-77.48", "33.45,-112.07"]

name: compare_sites
title: Compare 2 to 4 sites or markets
